law: each score_row is TP.score's row, verbatim; `beside` carries what the filed text requires ON the row and gates nothing; non-finite floats are written as null

f_c10_be.reason: P-BE-1 §9 (filed text): "if P-BE-1's filed book contains no tie and no 4h/5m mismatch latch bar, the leg must report NOT RUN with that reason. It must NOT substitute a synthetic bar or relabel a dip_first case to reach three." — P-BE-1's filed book (scored arm A1) contains NO tie and NO 4h/5m mismatch latch bar: 103 latch bars of 200 campaigns: dip-before 36, dip-after 0, print-no-dip 67, tie 0, 4h/5m mismatch 0; three-way agreement 103/103. Required classes absent: ['dip_after', 'tie_or_mismatch']. No synthetic bar is substituted and no dip_first case is relabelled; BE_CAMPAIGNS stays empty.

rows.halt: HALT: P-BE-1 — the arm shares the WHOLE campaign set with its base; the commissioned two-sample ruler's premise failed. File a NEW id under ruler='set_change' and disclose.
text_prescribes: If it does not move, this registration does NOT quietly become the narrower paired row — it HALTs. That HALT is part of the claim, and it is why the ruler is registered rather than left to the scorer.
If A1's two-sample premise fails and A1 HALTs, there is no report-only row on the same population to read instead; a new id must be filed under `set_change` and the reason disclosed.
